about: What Ozi says to Runners (ruling 44). Same format as config/ozi-phrases.json. Kept on the server only.

replies: Hello. Ready for a run? Say go on shift when you are.
Hi there. {motto}
You're welcome. Thank you for looking after our Shoppers.
Any time. Safe travels.
I'm well, thank you. How's your day going?
Very well. Ready when you are.

when: how much do i get paid
what do i earn per job
replies: You earn {runnerPay} for every job, whatever the size of the basket.
Every job pays you {runnerPay}. It never goes down.
You're paid for each job once it's delivered, to your own Stripe account.
After each delivery, your {runnerPay} goes to your Stripe account.
Your pay goes to your own Stripe account, set up in the app with your bank details.
Through Stripe, straight to your bank. We never hold your bank details ourselves.

when: do i pay for the shopping
do i use my own money
replies: The Shopper has already paid us. Check your job for how to pay at the till.
The Shopper paid when they ordered. Follow the payment steps on your job.
Tips aren't switched on yet. When they are, every penny of a tip will be yours.
Not yet. Tips are planned, and they'll go to you in full.

when: how do i go on shift
replies: Open your Runner page and press go on shift. Jobs near you will be offered.
Go to your Runner home and switch your shift on.

when: how do i go off shift
i want to stop for today
replies: Press go off shift on your Runner page. No new jobs will come.
Switch your shift off on your Runner home. Well done today.
Of course. Go off shift while you rest, and back on when you're ready.
Take your time. Go off shift and no jobs will be offered.
Jobs are offered to Runners on shift, in turn, near the shop. Stay on shift and one will come.
Keep your shift on. Jobs go round fairly, one Runner after another.

when: how do i accept a job
replies: Press accept on the job offer. It's yours once you do.
Accept it on the offer screen, then head to the shop.

when: can i turn down a job
replies: Yes. Let the offer pass, and it goes to the next Runner.
That's fine. It moves on to someone else.
Ask the Shopper from your job page. They'll say what they'd like instead.
Send the Shopper a question from the job. Never swap without asking.
Only if the Shopper agrees. Substitutions are never silent.
Ask first. The Shopper decides every swap.

when: what do i do with the receipt
replies: Enter the receipt total on your job before you deliver. The Shopper pays what the till said.
Put in the till total from the receipt. Keep the receipt for the Shopper.

when: do i need a cool bag
replies: Chilled and frozen food travels in a cool bag. The deposit for it comes out of your first jobs and is yours again later.
Yes, for cold things. The cool bag deposit is held from early jobs, not lost.
Never alcohol, tobacco, medicines or cash. We don't deliver any of them.
No alcohol, tobacco, medicines or cash, ever.

when: can i see the shopper's phone number
replies: Phone numbers are never shared. Use the call button in the app.
Call through the app. Nobody's number is ever shown.

when: what do i do at the door
how do i hand it over
replies: Read the doorstep note on your job. Knock, say who you are, and wait. Many Shoppers are slow to the door.
Follow the doorstep note, knock clearly, and give them time.

when: how do i help a blind shopper
replies: Say your name and that you're from us. Offer to put things where they ask, and read out anything they want checked.
Introduce yourself, and offer to carry things in and read labels. Never move things without asking.
Knock again and wait a few minutes. Then call through the app, and report a problem if you still can't hand over.
Try again, call through the app, and if there's still no one, report it from your job.

when: how do i report a problem
replies: Use report a problem on your job. Add a voice note, words or photos.
Report it from the job page, with whatever evidence you have.
If a problem is found to be your fault, up to 10 percent of that job is taken back, and only that.
At most 10 percent of the job, and only if a person decides it was your fault.

when: what do i need to send
replies: A photo of your face, your right to work, and a DBS check. Drivers also need a licence and insurance.
Face photo, right to work and DBS. Car or motorbike adds licence and insurance.
Your Runner page shows each document and whether it's been checked.
Look at documents on your Runner page. Each one says checked or waiting.
It's the code from the government's right to work service. Type it in and we check it on gov.uk.
Get it from gov.uk, prove your right to work, then give us the code.
Yes. A DBS check shows you're safe to work with the people we help.
A basic DBS certificate, or its share code.

when: can i change how i travel
replies: Yes, any time in your settings. A car or motorbike needs valid insurance first.
Change it in your Runner settings. Walking or cycling needs no insurance.
Only for a car or motorbike, with business use. On foot or by bicycle you don't.
Car and motorbike need business insurance. Feet and bikes don't.
If you are in danger, call 999 now. Your safety comes first, not the job.
Call 999 if you're in danger. Leave the job, we'll sort it out.
Take care out there. If it's not safe to travel, go off shift.
Stay safe. No job is worth an accident.
Press the call button on your job. Neither of you sees the other's number.
Use the in-app call. It's private both ways.
Your Training tab lists the modules. More is being added.
Look in the Training tab on your Runner page.
Thank you. Send it from Feedback on your Runner page. A person reads every one.
Please do, through Feedback on your Runner page.

when: how do i invite another runner
replies: Share your Runner ID. Anyone who signs up with it is linked to you.
Give friends your Runner ID from your Runner page.
I'm {assistant}, the {product} assistant. I help Runners and Shoppers. {motto}
I'm {assistant}. {motto}
{product} brings shopping to people who find it hard to get out, many of them blind or elderly. You're the one who brings it.
We shop for people who can't easily get to the shops. You make it happen.
For many of our Shoppers, you're the reason they eat well this week. That matters.
You're not just delivering. For some people you're the only visit today.
Ask me about pay, shifts, jobs, the shop, the door, documents or problems.
I can explain pay, shifts, jobs, what to do at the shop or the door, and your documents.
Of course. Ask me the question again and I'll answer.
Sure. Say it once more.
Report it from your job, and we'll sort the order out. Don't go to another shop without being asked.
Let us know through report a problem on the job.
Baskets are limited so one Runner can carry them safely. If it's too much for you, report it.
If you can't carry it safely, report it. Your safety matters.
Your earnings are big and bold on your Runner page, for today and over time.
Look at the top of your Runner page.

when: how many jobs can i do
replies: One job at a time. As soon as it's delivered, you can take the next.
One at a time, as many as you like in a shift.

when: can i bring someone with me
replies: Jobs are done by the Runner whose checks we've made, so please don't bring others to the door.
Only you, please. Your checks are what keep Shoppers safe.
Goodbye. Rest well.
See you next time. Thank you for today.

when: they want me to come in
replies: Only if the Shopper asks, and only as far as they need. Keep the visit short and kind.
If they ask, help bring things in, then leave as they'd like.

when: what if the shopping costs more
replies: Enter what the till says. The Shopper pays the till price, not the estimate.
The receipt decides. Just enter the true total.
